description: Migration, Cloning, and BCDR, powered by KubeDB Courier, extend KubeDB from running databases to moving, copying, and protecting them across clusters and data centers.
section_title: Move, Branch, and Protect Your Databases
section_subtitle: Migration, Cloning, and BCDR, powered by KubeDB Courier, extend KubeDB from running databases to moving, copying, and protecting them across clusters and data centers.

capabilities.title: BCDR: Near-Zero Data Loss, Near-Zero Downtime
capabilities.description: Keep your applications running when an entire data center goes down. KubeDB fails over automatically or on your command, and zero data loss is available for your most critical workloads.
benefits: Automatic failover with nobody to page, or manual control when you want to approve every move
Zero data loss available for your most critical workloads
Planned switchovers for maintenance and drills, with no data lost
Safe by design: only one site is ever in charge, even when the network splits
Built-in backup and point-in-time recovery for the mistakes replication cannot undo
One operating model across every supported database

capabilities.title: Live Migration
capabilities.description: Move to KubeDB from another cloud or an on-premises environment without stopping your applications. Your current system keeps serving traffic until you are ready to switch.
benefits: Powered by KubeDB Courier, enabled with a single Helm flag
No maintenance window: your users stay online during the move
Continuous sync keeps the new environment current until cutover
Cut over in minutes, as soon as the two sides are in step
Every move is declarative, versioned, and easy to track

capabilities.title: Cloning and Branching
capabilities.description: Give developers and test pipelines realistic data without putting production at risk. Isolated, refreshable branches are coming next.
benefits: Built on KubeDB Courier, the engine behind migration and branching
Realistic data for development, testing, and upgrade rehearsals
The same simple, declarative experience as the rest of KubeDB
Isolated, writable branches are coming next
